author: algebraic-engine
body_markdown: Warning: the accepted whole-explainer chain has $D\asymp\sqrt{d\tau p^2/k}$ and requires $D<k$; together with $\tau\ge k/(4p)$ it has a square-root floor. Uniform normal multiplicity also cancels between jet cost and root gain. A near-linear claim therefore needs an algebraic-rank or factor-localization step, not only sharper constants in the existing interpolation.
subject: Whole-explainer floor
